detail.title: META Pencil 300 Magnetic Stylus for iPad - Palm Rejection, White
detail.overview: The Ant META Pencil 300 is a precision stylus built for iPad and iPad Air models from 2018 onward, with palm rejection and tilt sensitivity for a natural, sketchbook-like writing and drawing feel. Its magnetic design lets it snap securely onto the side of a compatible iPad for pairing, charging and safe storage, while the fine POM tip glides smoothly across the screen without noticeable friction or lag. A long-lasting internal battery rated for up to 12 hours keeps it ready through extended note-taking, sketching or design sessions without frequent recharging. Lightweight and pencil-shaped for a familiar grip, it's a solid everyday tool for students, designers and note-takers on compatible iPad models.
